senses.gloss: to claim before court, to sue, to plead.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 13:4">Keth. XIII, 4</cite> <he>הטוֹעֵן את חבירו כדי וכ׳</he> if one claims from his neighbor a certain number of jugs of oil.
<cite ref="Ketubot 108b">Ib. 108ᵇ</cite>, a. e. <he>טְעָנוֹ חטין וכ׳</he> if one claims wheat and barley (two different things), and defendant admits barley.
<cite ref="Shevuot 43a:11">Shebu. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>עד שיִטְעֲנֶנּוּ בדבר וכ׳</he> until he sues him for something weighable or countable.
Gitt. 58ᵇ טוֹעֲנִין ליורש וכ׳ the court pleads in behalf of the heir &c.; a. v. fr.—Part. pass. טָעוּן, f. טְעוּנָה is required for, requires.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:7">Zeb. V, 7</cite> <he>דמן ט׳ הזייה</he> their blood is required for sprinkling (must be sprinkled).

Bicc. II, 1 טְעוּנִים רחיצת וכ׳ require washing of hands; a. v. fr.—Denom. טֹעַן, טוֹעַן requirement, obligation, fr. which טָ׳ טֹעַן to require. Sifra introd. ויצא מן הכלל לִיטְעוֹן ט׳ אחר שהוא וכ׳ and is specified for another requirement in keeping with the general subject.

senses.gloss: to seek after, to suspect, v. infra.
to be sued, to be respondent, defendant. Y. B. Kam. X, beg. 7ᵇ אפי׳ קטנים נִטְעָנִין להן בב״ד even for minors defense is made in court (prob. to be read: טוֹעֲנִין, cmp.
units: Gitt. 58ᵇ, quoted supra). [In later literature טוֹעֵן claimant, נִטְעָן defendant.]

senses.gloss: to be inquired after, suspected, to be summoned on suspicion.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 2:8">Yeb. II, 8</cite> <he>הנ׳ על א״א וכ׳</he> if one was suspected of intercourse with a married woman, and the court caused her to be sent away from him (her husband) on his account; <cite ref="Yevamot 24b">ib. 24ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 4:5">Tosef. ib. IV, 5</cite> <he>הניט׳ מא״א</he>. Y. ib. II, 4ᵃ bot. <he>בנ׳ בעדים</he> when the suspicion has been corroborated by witnesses.
